articles.headline: Luka Doncic touts his improved defense, draws praise from Lakers, Raptors
articles.description: Luka Doncic scored 45 points Sunday in the Lakers' 131-125 win over the Raptors, but it was his defensive impact that drew the most praise.

images.name: Luka Doncic [600x400]
images.caption: "Obviously, I'm not the best defender in the NBA, but I think this year, I really took a step forward," said Luka Doncic, who on Sunday became the first player to have five steals and draw three charges since player tracking began in 2013-14.

articles.headline: Yaxel Lendeborg scores 37 points, most by a Warriors rookie since Stephen Curry
articles.description: Yaxel Lendeborg hit six 3s and scored 37 points -- the most by a Warriors rookie since Stephen Curry in 2010 -- as Golden State beat the Clippers on Sunday night while resting Curry and Draymond Green.

images.name: Yaxel Lendeborg  [600x400]
images.caption: "One thing I'm proud of myself is my 3-point shot diet," Yaxel Lendeborg said Sunday. "Last year, if I would've missed like three 3s, I'm never shooting another one in the game. In Denver, I started off 0-for-5 and I kept shooting."
